scope: Authorized local simulation only; no CI, product packaging or device operations.
datasetMeaning: Synthetic boards with reverse-scramble witnesses. These are bounded search coverage figures, not independent real-game success estimates.

fixedStartMixed.oracle: Root checked legal fixed start, goal hits, combos and erased with the tracked oracle.

hintAudit.note: Internal heuristic score audit, not an independent solver or feasibility proof. Same-shape count2, 300 shuffled boards each, exclude those already having a goal hit. std::shuffle order is GCC/library-specific; printed boards preserve concrete examples.

rejectedExperiment.change: Choose maximum compatible subset among existing six hints instead of greedy; temporary solver copy only.
rejectedExperiment.conclusion: Does not establish a solve improvement. Not promoted to production.

finalToolValidation.note: Probe subsequently strengthened immutable-board check to all bytes; oracle stores independent first-wave Combo in rows. Recompiled final probe, verified all seven representative successes and misses.
